completion_data.completion_summary: Threaded Rulings 1, 2, 4, and 5 from Phase 1's linked-repo-write-policy.md record into rules/sapience-write-path.md and three existing domain docs (transcript-filter-ceiling.md, command-draft-and-picker.md, review-gate-boundary.md) as pure prose, corrected the rule file's stale corpus figure to the measured 5-of-14, completed its sanctioned-discussion-site list to six entries, and resynced index-entries.json line_count values for the three edited context files.

memory_candidates.content: generate-context-line-counts.sh refuses to run directly from the agent-system source store ('must run from a deployed scripts/ tree'), but it already supports a documented REPO_ROOT override: `REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh --write` runs cleanly from the source store and writes only the index-entries.json line_count fields that are actually stale, leaving every other field and array formatting untouched.

check-extension-docs.sh's doc-lint distinguishes a line_count-accuracy finding (Rule R, in source index-entries.json) from a 'deployed rule content drift (deployed != extension source)' finding -- the latter fires whenever a source-store instruction file is edited ahead of a redeploy, independent of Rule R, and is the expected transient state between a source edit and its next deploy rather than a regression in the edit itself.

sapience_notes.subject: Sapience linked-repo write-path rulings threaded into existing domain docs
sapience_notes.value: Rulings 1, 2, 4, and 5 governing how a Claude Code repo carrying .sapience/project.json differs from an unlinked one (write-tool grant, mid-run ban, transcript filtering, and member-suggestion surfacing) are each now stated directly in the surface that already owns that reasoning (rules/sapience-write-path.md, transcript-filter-ceiling.md, command-draft-and-picker.md, review-gate-boundary.md), citing the dedicated linked-repo-write-policy.md record rather than duplicating its rationale.

sapience_notes.subject: sapience-write-path.md's governed-corpus figure was stale
sapience_notes.value: The rule file's own corpus figure ('exactly three' .md instruction surfaces legitimately naming an MCP write tool, out of 14) was stale; a fresh grep for the four MCP write-tool names across the 14 .md instruction surfaces under agent-system/extensions/sapience/ found 5 (EXTENSION.md, the rule file itself, review-gate-boundary.md, linked-repo-write-policy.md, per-repo-scoping.md), all legitimate discussion sites rather than prescriptions.

sapience_notes.subject: generate-context-line-counts.sh REPO_ROOT override for source-store invocation
sapience_notes.value: generate-context-line-counts.sh's deploy-root-guard only fires when REPO_ROOT is unset; running `REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh --write` from the repo root is the sanctioned way to resync an extension's source-store index-entries.json line_count values without a redeploy detour, confirmed working live for the sapience extension (3 of 9 entries corrected, 0 unrelated changes).
